description: DiligenceOps: submit a proposed agent action in plain language (optionally with its amount) and a policy or mandate text. The signed report says whether the action fits: blocked, needs_condition, needs_detail, fits or not_addressed, citing each clause that allows, limits, requires or blocks it, comparing amount caps and approval thresholds exactly, and naming what the policy is silent on. POST /api/policy-fit-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

action.description: The proposed agent action in plain language, for example "Buy 3 monitors from Dell for $450".

amount.description: Optional amount of the action. Otherwise the first amount in the action text is used.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

policy.description: The policy, mandate or instruction text, up to 256 KB.

policy_label.description: Optional policy name, recorded in the report.

name: wever_policy-fit-check
title: Policy fit check
